tasks.text: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity. Solar electricity can reduce fossil-fuel use. Clouds can reduce instantaneous solar output. Batteries can store solar electricity for later use.

A database index stores an auxiliary search structure. An index can make selective queries faster. Indexes consume storage and add write overhead. Database indexes should be chosen for actual query patterns.

Vaccines train immune responses before exposure to a pathogen. Vaccination can reduce the risk of severe disease. No vaccine eliminates every infection. Population protection depends on the disease, vaccine, and coverage.

A satellite in low Earth orbit moves fast enough to keep falling around Earth. Atmospheric drag gradually removes orbital energy from low satellites. Higher low-Earth orbits usually experience less drag. Spacecraft can use propulsion to restore lost orbital energy.
